questions.question:
Identify the sentence that correctly uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial phrase.

A) Never before have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
B) So beautiful was the sunset that everyone stopped to admire it.
C) Before I had seen such a beautiful sunset.
D) Although I had seen such a beautiful sunset.
options: Never before have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
So beautiful was the sunset that everyone stopped to admire it.
Before I had seen such a beautiful sunset.
Although I had seen such a beautiful sunset.
questions.answer: So beautiful was the sunset that everyone stopped to admire it.

questions.question:
Which of the following sentences correctly employs a cleft sentence to highlight the location of the discovery?

A) It was in the old library that the historian found the rare manuscript.
B) The historian found the rare manuscript in the old library.
C) The rare manuscript was found in the old library by the historian.
D) The old library was where the historian found the rare manuscript.
options: It was in the old library that the historian found the rare manuscript.
The historian found the rare manuscript in the old library.
The rare manuscript was found in the old library by the historian.
The old library was where the historian found the rare manuscript.
questions.answer: It was in the old library that the historian found the rare manuscript.

questions.question:
Select the option that correctly uses the third conditional to discuss a hypothetical past situation with an impossible outcome.

A) If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it.
B) If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it, but it was too late.
C) If I had known about the meeting yesterday, I would have attended it.
D) If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it, but I was not aware of it at the time.
options: If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it.
If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it, but it was too late.
If I had known about the meeting yesterday, I would have attended it.
If I had known about the meeting, I would have attended it, but I was not aware of it at the time.
questions.answer: If I had known about the meeting yesterday, I would have attended it.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a formal recommendation?

A) I suggest that the committee members attend the meeting.
B) It is recommended that the committee members attend the meeting.
C) We suggest that the committee members attend the meeting.
D) The committee recommends that the members attend the meeting.
options: I suggest that the committee members attend the meeting.
It is recommended that the committee members attend the meeting.
We suggest that the committee members attend the meeting.
The committee recommends that the members attend the meeting.
questions.answer: It is recommended that the committee members attend the meeting.

questions.question:
Identify the sentence that correctly demonstrates ellipsis, where a word is omitted but understood from context.

A) She is taller than her sister, but he is shorter than his brother.
B) She is taller than her sister, and he is shorter than his brother.
C) She is taller than her sister, but her brother is shorter than him.
D) She is taller than her sister, but her brother is shorter than she.
options: She is taller than her sister, but he is shorter than his brother.
She is taller than her sister, and he is shorter than his brother.
She is taller than her sister, but her brother is shorter than him.
She is taller than her sister, but her brother is shorter than she.
questions.answer: She is taller than her sister, but her brother is shorter than him.
